title: Coordination-number constraints: two constraints, two secondary types
purpose: Exercises two simultaneous coordination-number constraints in the `epsr` engine [@soper1996,@soper2005,@epsrmanual], one with two neighbour types, acting on both water and DMSO.
system: The EPSR-test system: a liquid mixture of 200 dimethyl sulphoxide (DMSO, (CH3)2SO) and 400 water molecules (DMSO mole fraction 1/3; 3200 atoms) at 300 K in a cubic box of side 33.12 Å (atomic number density 0.0881 atoms/Å³). DMSO uses EPSR's Lennard-Jones + Coulomb reference potential with methyl rotational groups; water uses SPC/E Lennard-Jones and charge parameters [@berendsen1987] with EPSR's flexible intramolecular geometry (O-H 0.976 Å). The empirical potential is refined against three neutron diffraction data sets of deuterated DMSO in D2O, in null-scattering H2O/D2O and in H2O (ISIS SANDALS runs SLS03863, SLS03871, SLS03850), the isotope-substitution approach of Soper and Luzar [@soperluzar1992]. A `coordcon atc nc cctemp ccdistort ccgaussweight ccgausswidth ats ds dsmax ...` line asks each atom of type `atc` to have `nc` neighbours of type `ats` on other molecules; `find_constraints` assigns explicit bonds and each bond adds a Morse-form energy [@morse1929] (`en_harmonic`) plus an optional harmonic/linear term; constraint-bonded pairs use the reference potential without extra Gaussians or repulsive core. Here water O1 should have 3 neighbours (H1 at 1.85/2.6 Å, O1 at 2.8/3.4 Å) and DMSO O 2 H1 neighbours (1.9/2.7 Å, no extra term).
inputs: EPSR-test unchanged (`ntimes 5`, `niter 1`) except two `coordcon` lines appended to the `.pcof`: `coordcon O1 3 4.0 0.8 0.3 0.5 H1 1.85 2.6 O1 2.8 3.4` and `coordcon O 2 6.0 1.2 0.0 0.0 H1 1.9 2.7`. `commands.txt`: `epsr 200DMSO400Water.EPSR.inp`, `repeat 3`.
verification: The line is rewritten by `save_files_others` as a 256-character record, so passes 2 and 3 re-read the program's own format; `coordcon.txt` (written by `fmolec1`) is compared too. Exercised beyond ex115: two constraints in `check_coord_bonded`/`en_mole_coord`/`writecoordcons`, two secondary types (same-type O1-O1 bonds store no reverse bond), and `save_coord_energies` after DMSO internal rotations (passes 2 and 3 diverge if it is omitted, per the README). Constraint energy -11.80 kJ/mol per molecule.
notes: Reproduced: `save_coord_energies` is only called after accepted internal rotations, so `ergold_coord` keeps its `fmolec1` value after whole-molecule moves; the pass-2 removal search stops at slot 2; stale bond-array slots are read in pass 3.
